# Sheria360
> AI-Powered Integrated Legal, Case, and Contracts Lifecycle Management System engineered to manage complex legal workflows with precision, speed, and efficiency for law firms and corporate legal departments.

This directory lists clean markdown context files, core system capabilities, departmental workflows, and support resources mapped out for automated agent ingestion and data context matching.

## Core Platform & Features
* [Homepage](https://sheria360.com): Platform overview and legal operations dashboard.
* [All Features](https://sheria360.comfeatures.html): Comprehensive platform feature lists and integrations.
* [Legal Services Management](https://sheria360.comlegalservices.html): Alternative dispute resolution, civil, and criminal case modules.
* [Case Management](https://sheria360.comcase-management.html): Complete client intake, active investigations, and evidence custody tracking.
* [Contract Lifecycle Management](https://sheria360.comcontracts-management.html): Multi-channel drafting automation, template parameters, and signature tracking.
* [Artificial Intelligence Engine](https://sheria360.comai.html): Contextual contract suggestions, redlining tools, and research utilities.
* [Client Collaboration Portal](https://sheria360.comclientportal.html): Secure external messaging pipelines, file exchanges, and client onboarding.
* [Billing Management](https://sheria360.combilling.html): Time-tracking captures, automatic invoice distribution, and financial ledgers.

## Tailored Solutions
* [All Solutions](https://sheria360.comsolutions.html): Complete list of corporate and consulting structural workflows.
* [In-House Legal Departments](https://sheria360.cominhouse.html): Tailored setups optimized for corporate entities and internal workflow routing.
* [Law Firms](https://sheria360.comlaw-firms.html): Software features adapted for modern practicing firms and firm analytics tracking.
* [Procurement & Supply Chain](https://sheria360.comprocurement.html): Automated vendor intake parameters and structural supply risks analysis.
* [Finance & Legal Ops](https://sheria360.comfinance.html): Cost allocation engines, automated invoice reviews, and ledger tracking.

## Corporate & Support Resources
* [About Sheria360](https://sheria360.comabout-sheria.html): Background details,State institution partnerships, and system architecture metrics.
* [Pricing Plans](https://sheria360.comprice.html): Comparative summary of Core, Professional, and Enterprise system tiers.
* [Frequently Asked Questions](https://sheria360.comfaq.html): Categorized self-service troubleshooting, support layers, and framework details.
* [Contact Us](https://sheria360.comcontact.html): Interactive booking inquiry routing, phone channels, and headquarters directions.
